name: Faust: Scene II
source:
A kinetic novel illustrating a scene from J. W. Goethe's Faust in which the characters happen to be women.
Text adapted from Martin Greenberg's 1992 English translation. 

[Edited from [url=https://meagantrott.itch.io/faust-scene-ii]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部动态小说，描绘了歌德《浮士德》中的一个场景，其中的角色恰好是女性。
文本改编自马丁·格林伯格1992年的英文翻译。

[编辑自[url=https://meagantrott.itch.io/faust-scene-ii]itch.io[/url]]
